scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs all
scripts.test:host: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs host
scripts.test:portable: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs portable
scripts.verify:portable: npm run doctor && npm run typecheck && npm run test:portable
scripts.project:init: npm run build && node dist/src/local-runtime/project-cli.js init
scripts.project:plan: npm run build && node dist/src/local-runtime/project-cli.js plan
scripts.project:prepare: npm run build && node dist/src/local-runtime/project-cli.js prepare
scripts.project:inspect: npm run build && node dist/src/local-runtime/live-cli.js inspect
scripts.project:run: npm run build && node dist/src/local-runtime/live-cli.js run
scripts.probe:live-native: npm run build && FORGEMIND_NATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC=1 node --test dist/tests/live-workflow/native.test.js
